Shared mask accessors, per processor cacheinfo accessor, leaf count helper, topology counts, descriptor table layout, and full northbridge init.

findings.text: Init entry coordinates split and bus lock handling by first running model detection, then state initialization, then status reporting.
Vendor cache topology helpers expose AMD last level identification, Hygon equivalent, Hygon leaf counting, and Intel full detection.
Generic cacheinfo helpers validate leaf availability and populate per processor leaf descriptors with sharing maps.
Cache and memory range control offers paired disable and enable operations, a per processor init driver, and a guarded register writer plus state sync.
In the routed header configuration the AMD northbridge cache helper is an inline that yields no object.
Boot time split lock setup is the processor identification entry that must run before state reporting.
Per processor caching init is the entry that quiesces caches around memory type updates and initializes page attributes.
Cache leaf population is the entry that enumerates deterministic leaves, assigns identifiers, initializes descriptors, and builds sharing maps.

Split lock support stays disabled under hypervisor; otherwise either model table match or core capabilities feature plus architectural core caps bit is required before marking support and invoking low level setup.

Status reporting stays silent when neither bus nor split detection exists or when state is off; rate limited state reports bus rate and returns; fatal state changes user wording; split capable path also attempts offline handler install while bus only path reports bus action.
Deterministic leaf acceptance rejects null type and otherwise stores leaves and derives total size from incremented set, line, partition, and way fields.
Leaf filling dispatches by boot vendor with AMD and Hygon sharing one path and all others using Intel path; AMD path further selects extended topology leaf when supported else legacy synthesis.

Legacy synthesis clears outputs, reads historical leaves, selects instruction or data level one or level two or three by index, drops empty or invalid encodings, and synthesizes initializing type level sharing core count associativity line partition and set fields.
Cache identifiers derive by shifting the APIC identifier right by the order of the sharing width, with topology variant masking low bits instead to form aligned group base.

AMD last level identification is skipped without level three, uses die identifier before Zen, shifted APIC form for early Zen family, and sharing based calculation for newer families; Hygon always uses shifted APIC form.

Hygon init records leaf count; Intel completion backfills last level identifier from package when unset, selects largest available cache size preferring higher levels, and probes sizes when level two is missing.

Intel detection prefers deterministic enumeration when available and only falls back to historical descriptor summation; deterministic walk accumulates per level sizes and records level two and three topology identifiers with last level falling back to level two.

AMD sharing setup gives level three the precomputed last level mask; with topology extensions it groups online processors by APIC interval derived from sharing width; otherwise it signals caller to use generic path.
Generic sharing setup delegates AMD and Hygon first, always marks self, exits early for private caches, and otherwise links online peers whose shifted APIC identifiers match in both directions.

Descriptor initialization copies identifier, marks cache identity attribute, translates internal type through mapping table, and stores level plus incremented line ways size sets and partition along with northbridge handle.

Disable sequence takes global lock, enters no fill mode, flushes caches, saves and clears global pages when supported, flushes local translation with counting, disables memory ranges when supported, and flushes again; enable reverses translation flush, range restore, cache enable, page restore, and unlock.

Range disable saves default type register then writes back disabled uncached form; enable restores saved words; state sync rewrites variable and fixed ranges plus default type and accumulates variable fixed and default change flags into global mask bit by bit.
Fixed range sync checks AMD DRAM modify guard, iterates descriptor blocks and per block registers, and only writes registers whose halves differ while reporting whether any changed.
Processor caching init saves interrupts, runs disable state sync enable triplet only when memory type flag is set, runs page attribute init only when its flag is set, then restores interrupts.

Global cache disable lock serializes no fill entry, translation and cache flushes, control register updates, and memory range changes; disable acquires and enable releases, and callers must hold it across the whole quiesce window.

Deterministic EAX carries type level initializing fully associative reserved thread sharing and core count fields; EBX carries line partition and ways; ECX carries set count; aggregate adds identifier and byte size alongside the three leaves.
Legacy level one descriptor packs line size lines per tag associativity and kilobyte size; level two widens size and narrows tag and associativity; level three adds reserved bits and encoded size.
Small tables map internal null data instruction unified codes to external cache types, translate encoded associativity values to counts, and give per index level and type for legacy synthesis.

Per processor last level and second level sharing masks plus global cacheinfo mask track topology groups; saved control value preserves page state; caching control word gates memory type and page attribute paths; split model table lists supported variants with terminator.

Split and bus handling moves from model detection to state setup to reporting; reporting branches on off versus rate limit versus fatal versus warn, with split capable and bus only outputs and conditional offline handler install.
Cache quiesce moves from normal to locked no fill flushed translation cleared ranges disabled and back to normal unlocked restored, with page save and restore bracketing the window.
Memory type sync moves from current registers to desired state comparison to selective rewrites to change mask accumulation to global mask publication.

Cache flush is skipped when self snoop is available; translation flushes are counted; offline handler install failure only warns; register write failure only logs; firmware DRAM modify bit triggers warning and corrective clear.

Empty fully associative and invalid associativity encodings, zero leaf counts, missing descriptor lists, offline peers, absent level three, and level below minimum all yield empty or fallback results rather than errors except leaf validation and population propagation.
Internal cache type codes are null 0 data 1 instruction 2 unified 3; fully associative marker is 0xffff; invalid AMD level two and three associativity code is 0x9.
Deterministic enumeration uses leaf 4 for Intel and leaf 0x8000001d for AMD with extensions, while legacy synthesis reads leaves 0x80000005 and 0x80000006.
Legacy per index levels are 1 1 2 3 and types are 1 2 3 3; encoded associativity decodes as 5 to 6, 6 to 8, 8 to 16, 0xa to 32, 0xb to 48, 0xc to 64, 0xd to 96, 0xe to 128, 0xf to fully associative.

Early AMD and Hygon last level groups derive from APIC identifier shifted right by 3; family divides are below 0x17, equal 0x17 with model up to 0x1F, and newer; SYSCFG guard applies from family 0x0F on AMD.
